notes: Transcribed from sue604-evaluation.md §3.2 (unseen-topic holdout, no BEFORE baseline exists). reg-report-hedge-language is present at ten hedge predicates against one in the comparable bonds-report -- "at the edge of over-application" per the evaluation, recorded as an observation, not a FAIL. This is F6 (routes to 'native_fluency': agentless forecast predicates such as "...예상보다 길어질 것으로 전망된다", "...평가가 나온다" erase whose forecast it is, per nq-passive-causative-overuse -- the defect is the agentless predicate choice, not the hedging itself, so fixing it at the register layer would wrongly weaken a correctly-applied hedging rule). Comparative dimensions abstain: not assessed by the source evaluation. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
